lines: Faculty of Science Postgraduate Writing-Up Award 2025

The Faculty of Science Postgraduate Writing-Up Award 2025 is an opportunity offered by the University of Melbourne to graduate research students. It aims to assist students enrolled through the Faculty of Science once their thesis has been submitted. Selected candidates will receive a stipend of AUD 3,000-5,000.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
have submitted their Ph.D./M.Phil. thesis for examination and awaiting the examination result
not have received any similar awards
not participate in full-time/part-time employment during the tenure of the award
International graduate researchers must commit to spending at least 66% of their time in Melbourne during the writing up of articles.
Graduate researchers returning to their home country following submission of their thesis are ineligible.
Selected candidates will receive a one-time stipend of AUD 3,000-5,000 paid over 3 months.
Note: Applicants who apply with fewer than two manuscripts may be considered for a lesser amount.

Question: Who is offering this opportunity?
This opportunity is offered by the University of Melbourne.
Question: Are there any application fees?
No, only the writing award is offered.
Question: Are there extra benefits for disabled students?
All candidates will receive equal benefits.
Question: What is the mode of application?
The application is online through the official website.
